judged_text: The only test that runs with the gating satisfied stubs poll_feed itself ('poller.expects(:poll_feed).once'), so the entire body of Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed (SimpleRSS parsing, the url = i.id fallback for links not matching /^https?/, CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub), and the TopicEmbed.import call) is never executed by any test in this diff. A regression in poll_feed — e.g. a feed item whose link is blank and whose item has no id attribute raising NoMethodError, or content mangled before import — ships green; the spec file exists but only verifies that the three SiteSetting guards short-circuit execute, so operators get silent feed-import failures with a passing suite.

adjudication.rationale: In this diff, the newly added `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` contains nontrivial logic (SimpleRSS parsing via `SimpleRSS.parse open(...)`, per-item URL normalization with `url = i.id if url.blank? || url !~ /^https?\:\/\//`, HTML unescaping/scrubbing via `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`, and `TopicEmbed.import(...)`). The added spec `spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb` only asserts guard conditions in `execute` and that `execute` delegates to `poll_feed` by stubbing/expecting `poll_feed` itself (`poller.expects(:poll_feed).once`), so it never exercises the body of `poll_feed`. No other new spec in the diff calls `poll_feed` directly either, so regressions inside `poll_feed` could pass the test suite unnoticed.
